items.title: Ralph LaLama interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 23, 2010
items.q: I mean like Monk. Monk. Speaking of Monk

ctx.x: And she has great ears too. You know what I mean? But I’m just saying I’m joking but I’m not. I’m serious about what I’m saying. But she doesn’t actually holler at me, but I know she can tell when I hit it. But when you’re trying to improvise, sometimes you get hung up. So if you just play all your licks that are comfortable, all your stuff, then you’re not going to mess up. Then I don’t think you’re really improvising. You know what I mean? I mean like Monk. Monk. Speaking of Monk, [scats] it’s obviously — not a…
We’ll quote you on that. You’ll make our little snippets of good quotes.
